# manifold_threat_detection_rules (Data Source)

Lists threat detection rules and how each is tuned. Filters combine with AND; values within one filter combine with OR. Needs the `read:threats` scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "manifold_threat_detection_rules" "disabled" {
  enabled = false
}

output "disabled_rule_ids" {
  value = [for r in data.manifold_threat_detection_rules.disabled.rules : r.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `categories` (Set of String) Only rules in these categories.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Only rules that run, or only those switched off.
- `framework` (String) Only rules mapping to this taxonomy code, e.g. `OWASP-ASI02`.
- `ids` (Set of String) Only these rule ids.
- `query` (String) Case-insensitive substring match on id, title or description.
- `severities` (Set of String) Only rules with these severities.

### Read-Only

- `rules` (Attributes List) Matching rules, most recently tuned first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String)
- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 creation timestamp.
- `description` (String) What the rule looks for, in one line.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule runs. A disabled rule raises nothing new.
- `id` (String) The rule's identifier, the `detection_rule_id` threats name.
- `owner` (String) Who maintains the rule.
- `severity` (String) Severity the threats this rule raises inherit.
- `taxonomy_mappings` (List of String) Framework codes the rule maps to, e.g. `OWASP-ASI02`.
- `title` (String)
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the last retune.
